positions.title: Jr. Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designs, modifies, and develops software application components for displays, controls, and systems for mobile machinery. 
Worked on multitasking system with Freescale's HC12 & HC08 family of MCUs.
Experience working with low level control processing (Interrupts, Timers, Digital I/O), serial communication protocols (RS232) with RTOS.
Involved in development of CANOPEN & SAEJ1939 protocol.
Experience with board level support. 
Developed CANOPEN boot-loader to download software into flash on a processor via CANBUS.
Write some scripts (shell scripts) to support production.
Use subversion repository as version control system to keep the track of software development.
Use Trac for software project management.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Worked as a Teaching Assistant under Dr. B. Aliane, in the Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering.
Helped students of junior level in the subjects of signal processing and communication techniques. 
Managed and maintaining about 100 computers spanning over 5 laboratories.
Assisted students from freshmen to Masters Level, with their problems using computer.

positions.title: Research & Development Engineer
positions.description:
Pantech Instruments, India
Worked on to develop design and integrated testing of RPM meter right from the designing stage till QC and also responsible for onsite commissioning for the meter with periodic check to know more about the stability of the design.
Develop software in Assembly programming for controller with requisite software test for the device. Also involved in testing of Flow meter, Temperature Indicators/Controllers.
